page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance from the Enhanced instance family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs operating on Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 512.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. There are no onboard graphics processing units (GPUs) included with this hardware specification.

Storage architecture relies entirely on external network-attached volumes, as the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge features no local storage. The primary networking component is a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps, delivering substantial network throughput for distributed systems. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not bundled, requiring standard cloud networking allocation for direct external routing.

The qualitative profile of this server type focuses on massive network throughput paired with high core and memory capacity. For deployment architectures requiring intense data interchange without dedicated accelerator chips, the 160 Gbps network interface offsets the absence of integrated local NVMe storage. Suitable workloads include large-scale enterprise applications, high-throughput network middleboxes, distributed databases, memory-backed distributed caching systems, and high-traffic web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an enterprise-grade general-purpose instance within the Enhanced family, driven by a KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs via Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory for an even 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Designed without integrated GPUs or local drive storage, the instance relies on remote block storage solutions. Its defining feature is a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps, enabling massive inter-node communication and data ingestion. Given its high core density, substantial RAM, and extensive networking capabilities, ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is aligned with network-intensive workloads, distributed in-memory databases, large-scale microservice platforms, and big data processing clusters.
